summary: Move sprite from red marker region to green marker region, recoloring it to match the green region's original sprite color, while turning the source sprite location grey and removing both markers.
src: sprite sitting on red marker pixel region s
dst: position of sprite sitting on green marker pixel region d
transform: s.color -> d.original_sprite.color; s.original_location -> grey; markers -> disappear
symbol_instructions: red pixel marks source sprite to move; green pixel marks destination where sprite transfers with color change
multi_step: Step 1: identify red and green marker pixels; Step 2: move sprite above red marker to position above green marker; Step 3: recolor moved sprite to match original sprite color at destination; Step 4: turn original source sprite location to grey; Step 5: remove both marker pixels
